dataset.name: Neuroblastoma (TARGET-NBL)
dataset.description: Public GDC-harmonized bulk RNA-seq from primary TARGET neuroblastoma tumors with an overall-survival contract from diagnosis.
dataset.cohort_context: Pediatric neuroblastoma in TARGET-NBL. Only primary tumors are eligible; recurrent tumors and recurrent bone-marrow material are separate clinical states and are excluded before one sample is chosen per patient.

metadata.source_program: Therapeutically Applicable Research to Generate Effective Treatments (TARGET)
metadata.sample_selection_note: Primary Tumor is the only allowed sample type. Recurrent tumor and recurrent blood-derived bone-marrow files are rejected before deterministic one-patient/one-profile selection.
metadata.excluded_material: Eight Recurrent Tumor files and one Recurrent Blood Derived Cancer - Bone Marrow file at the source cutoff.
metadata.treatment_note: Primary tumor denotes specimen origin and does not by itself prove treatment-naive status.
metadata.endpoint_note: OS is measured from diagnosis by the GDC survival endpoint. GDC release corrections must be reviewed before promotion.
metadata.overlap_note: TARGET-derived samples present in harmonized pediatric resources such as OpenPedCan/GMKF must not be counted as independent validation patients.

expression.label: log2(TPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: GDC STAR-counts GENCODE v36 gene_id and gene_name fields
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Distinct Ensembl gene identifiers sharing one supplied symbol are excluded rather than merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The GDC STAR-counts files supply non-negative tpm_unstranded values. TRACE Explorer applies log2(TPM + 1) once.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Diagnosis as implemented by the GDC survival endpoint
